newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa to swap 4 shares for 10 UAP.
newsitem.headline: Axa to swap 4 shares for 10 UAP.

text.p: A merger between Axa and Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) will be made on the basis of four Axa shares for 10 UAP shares, plus certificates of contigent value, UAP head Jacques Friedmann said.
"The starting point is four for 10, plus certificates of contigent value which complete the terms," he told reporters as he arrived for a joint news conference with Axa.
The certificates guarantee a price for UAP shares of 157 francs per share, Axa Chairman Claude Bebear said.
UAP shares closed on Friday at 116.9 francs per share, compared to their 1994 privatisation price of 152 francs per share. Shares in Axa and UAP were suspended on Tuesday.
